correctness.rationale: Under s=2n+1 dividing 3a+4, direct congruences give s|A,C, gcd(B,s)=1, gcd(A/s,C/s)=1. The identity (n+1)A+nC=sB preserves length and supplies an explicit bijection from each original factorization to a unique reduced y=r factorization plus a bounded nonnegative trade count. Coprime two-coin Diophantine solutions exactly enumerate x=x0+vj,z=z0−uj with 0<=j<=floor(z0/u), and allowable inverse trades count h_j. This proves no missed lengths/duplicates for every M>=0; v−u=2a gives all gaps and the M=suv witness makes delta={2a}. Independently compared 924 targets across four admissible (a,n) parameter sets against brute-force enumeration; not a proof in place of modular bijection.
residual_risks: The classification is limited to divisibility subfamily s|3a+4; relation to known gluing formulas is an originality risk.

originality.rationale: Qualified originality of the all-element closed multiplicity profile in this arithmetic generalized-star subfamily, not of modular inverses, two-coin solutions or homogeneous trades. Yin–Mu–Komatsu 2024 studies the SAME triple but p-Frobenius largest numbers by representation count, not all individual elements’ factorization length distributions. Garcia–O’Neill–Yih 2019 gives the generic length-preserving-trade mechanism and asymptotic mode/mean/median, including counting factorizations at a fixed length in a proof; this is substantial relevant prior methodology, yet its published main theorems do not state the exact no-threshold star-family h_j. There remains a serious risk a broader gluing normal form yields the formula by short specialization.
residual_risks: A general gluing or three-generator homogeneous-trade theorem may imply the exact stated formula directly; specific priority comparison beyond accessed sources remains needed.
Arithmetic bijection is elementary; novelty is the explicit exact complete histogram, not the underlying trade.

value.rationale: Factorization length multisets and delta sets are standard invariants in numerical semigroup theory. The full exact M-dependent histogram with multiplicities is not the same as genus or Frobenius bounds; the nonempty infinite symmetric generalized-star subfamily is arithmetically motivated by s|A,C and a homogeneous relation. Exact no-threshold support and h_j may be used directly by researchers studying factorization statistics. Value is specialized and grounded in this exact invariant, not claimed as a new general gluing theory.
residual_risks: May be a short instance of a published broader gluing enumeration; if established as already directly covered, novelty/value would require re-evaluation.

limitations: Only a>=4,n>=2, (2n+1)|(3a+4); no claim for complementary parameters.
2019 general length-preserving trade machinery is known prior art; potential stronger gluing/length formula remains a specific originality risk.
